## Research Interest

I work on empirical micro-development economics, at the intersection of technology, institutions and structural transformation. See more of my works on the [Research](research.qmd) or [Projects](projects.qmd) page.

## Background

- **Graduate Student, Economic Development**, [Graduate School of International Development, Nagoya University](https://www4.gsid.nagoya-u.ac.jp/en/), under [Prof. Christian Otchia](http://profs.provost.nagoya-u.ac.jp/html/100010239_ja.html). MEXT Scholar, 2024–2027.
- **Associate Project Manager**, [Cietra Indonesia Utama], [2019-2024]. Co-managed 10+ international projects and led nine APEC capacity-building initiatives for Indonesian government clients.
- **Communications consultancy**, [Maverick Indonesia](https://maverick.co.id/), [2022-2023]. Improved how businesses are perceived by the public across different sectors.
- **Bachelor of International Relations**, [Universitas Pembangunan Nasional Veteran Jakarta](https://www.upnvj.ac.id/en.html), [2018-2022], Outstanding Student Award (2020).

## Community & Leadership

- **Chairman**, Indonesian Student Association in Nagoya (PPI Nagoya), 2024–2025
- **Vice President**, Foreign Policy Community of Indonesia, UPNVJ Chapter, 2019–2020
